tactics.townyrecruits.controls: ← / →: facing · Wheel: width · Left click: issue order
tactics.townyrecruits.rejected: No recruits can perform this order.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.march: Keeps ranks together; turns before departure and after arrival.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.move: Aim at the ground; ← / → set facing, left click confirms.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.hold: Aim at the ground; ← / → set facing, left click confirms.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.return: Aim at the ground; ← / → set facing, left click confirms.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.advance: Aim at the ground; ← / → set facing, left click confirms.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.retreat: Shields or pikes face the enemy while withdrawing slowly. Keep formation leaves a central passage.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.face: Aim at the ground; ← / → set facing, left click confirms.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.bomb_area: One bomb per recruit. 2.5-block scatter, 15-minute cooldown. Green: ready, red: unavailable.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.bomb_line: One bomb per recruit. 2.5-block scatter, 15-minute cooldown. Green: ready, red: unavailable.
tactics.townyrecruits.failure.arc: Out of throwing range or obstructed arc
tactics.townyrecruits.failure.busy: Busy, hungry, fleeing or unable to control this vehicle
tactics.townyrecruits.failure.front: Choose a point at least 4 blocks in front of the formation
tactics.townyrecruits.route_controls: Left click: add point · Enter: march · Backspace: undo
tactics.townyrecruits.route_help: ↑ / ↓: formation · ← / →: facing · Wheel: width · Right click / Esc: cancel
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.route: Place up to 8 points. ↑ / ↓ change formation, wheel changes width, left click adds a point. Enter starts the confirmed route; Backspace removes the last point.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.hold_front: Anchor each recruit at its current slot. Melee pursuit cannot exceed the selected pursuit limit.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.fire_hold: Load and aim, but wait for a volley order. No ammunition is consumed while waiting.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.free_fire: Fire whenever loaded and a hostile target has a clear firing lane. Friendly recruits and their mounts block shots.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.volley: Ready shooters fire once on the same tick. Blocked shooters wait for a clear lane; then everyone holds fire.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.rank_fire: Ranks alternate volleys while the others reload. Continue until hold fire, free fire or cancel orders.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.keep_distance: Approach or withdraw to keep the selected distance from the current enemy. A held front still limits movement.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.hit_and_run: Mounted melee soldiers charge an enemy near the aimed point, strike, break away and return to their starting positions.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.carousel: Mounted archers approach, shoot while sweeping a semicircle, escape along an outer semicircle and reload before returning.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.end_manoeuvre: Stop hit-and-run or carousel and hold the current position.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.speed: Cycle slow, normal, quick and run. Applies to selected recruits immediately and to new movement orders.
tactics.townyrecruits.tip.cancel: Stop movement, queued waypoints, manoeuvres and pending volleys. Hold here with weapons silent.
tactics.townyrecruits.failure.mount: A controlled horse or camel is required
tactics.townyrecruits.failure.target: No hostile target near this point
tactics.townyrecruits.failure.frontline: A shield or pike is required for facing withdrawal
army.townyrecruits.rout: The company broke under losses and is fleeing!
